name: Statuspage
label: Statuspage REST API
description: Statuspage API v1 at https://api.statuspage.io/v1. Docs: https://developer.statuspage.io/. Incident/component/subscriber fields nest under incident / component / subscriber. Auth: Authorization OAuth {api_key}. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log api_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: page_get | incident_create | incident_update | incident_list | component_get | component_update | subscriber_add | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'page_get'.

schema.label: incident_id
schema.description: Incident id.

schema.label: component_id
schema.description: Component id.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Incident name (incident.name) on incident_create (required) / incident_update, or component.name on component_update. Example: Slow API responses.

schema.label: status
schema.description: incident_create/update: investigating | identified | monitoring | resolved. component_update: operational | degraded_performance | partial_outage | major_outage | under_maintenance.

schema.label: impact_override
schema.description: incident.impact_override on incident_create. none | minor | major | critical.

schema.label: body
schema.description: Incident message nested as incident.body on incident_create / incident_update (first/next update text).

schema.label: email
schema.description: subscriber.email on subscriber_add. Email or phone_number required.

schema.label: phone_number
schema.description: subscriber.phone_number on subscriber_add (E.164).

schema.label: component_ids
schema.description: Affected component ids nested as incident.component_ids on incident_create / incident_update.

schema.label: components
schema.description: Map of component_id → new status nested as incident.components, e.g. {"abc":"degraded_performance"}.

schema.label: deliver_notifications
schema.description: incident.deliver_notifications on incident_create / incident_update. Default true.

schema.label: description
schema.description: component.description on component_update.

schema.label: skip_confirmation_notification
schema.description: subscriber.skip_confirmation_notification on subscriber_add.

schema.label: incident
schema.description: Incident object with name/status/body for incident_create/update. Example: {"name":"Outage","status":"investigating","body":"Looking into it"}.

schema.label: component
schema.description: Component object with status for component_update. Example: {"status":"major_outage"}.

schema.label: subscriber
schema.description: Subscriber object with email for subscriber_add. Example: {"email":"ops@example.com"}.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: page_get, incident_create, incident_update, incident_list, component_get, component_update, subscriber_add, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Statuspage API key. Authorization: OAuth <key> (header only; query api_key retired 2026-05-15). Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Incident
configurationParameters.description: Incident object with name/status/body for incident_create/update. Example: {"name":"Outage","status":"investigating","body":"Looking into it"}.

configurationParameters.label: Component
configurationParameters.description: Component object with status for component_update. Example: {"status":"major_outage"}.

configurationParameters.label: Subscriber
configurationParameters.description: Subscriber object with email for subscriber_add. Example: {"email":"ops@example.com"}.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
